description:
Skills Required: Experience performing configuration management with Team Foundation Server (TFS) Experience performing configuration management for .NET applications using SQL Server database management system Experience with configuration management with web-based applications Experience building and deploying packages for a client-server and web-based applications Object Oriented Programming, WCF, VB.NET, SOA, Visual Studio 2008, Enterprise Library, MSMQ, Security Fundamentals, SSIS, SSRS, ASP.NET, MVC, HTML and SQL 
 Skills Preferred:  
 Experience Required : At least 7 years experience with Team Foundation Server (TFS) configuring & administration At least 7 years experience performing configuration management activities of web based applications At least 10 years experience with web development in VB.NET and ASP.NET At least 8 years experience as a .NET technical leader At least 10 years experience with web development and a SQL backend At least 3 years experience with MVC 4.0 or higher .NET technologies and frameworks Experience with object oriented programming concepts, leading code reviews, enforcing development standards, refining software development and build processes, and assisting with quality improvement activities related to software development. Experience with SSIS and SSRS  
 Experience Preferred: At least 2 years experience with MSMQ.  

 

 

 


 Education Required: A bachelor's degree or higher with ot less than 21 semester (32 term) hours in computer science, data processing, computer information systems, data communications, networking, systems analysis, computer programming or mathematics. 

 
 Thanks & Regards
